title: Scenario UX post-change comparison

changes.before: Flat snapshots were the primary user-facing unit
changes.after: Scenario is a named lineage with immutable Versions and a compact overview

changes.before: Save current created another Scenario snapshot
changes.after: Save version creates a new immutable Version with optional change summary and parent Version

changes.before: Switching restored a snapshot without Version context
changes.after: Switcher shows latest Version, parent relation, updated time, and Unsaved changes state

changes.before: No Version history or input diff
changes.after: Version list, RF/cell/receiver/interference/optimization/dataset/AOI diff, continue, and branch actions

changes.before: Optimization apply and Scenario identity were loosely connected
changes.after: Version and branch application preserve parent, originating Run, and originating solution lineage
Friendly Scenario + Version labels and source navigation
Friendly Scenario + Version metadata and Open Version navigation
Scenario + Version input-state comparison first; retained RF result comparison is shown only when semantically compatible

changes.before: Historical apply path could implicitly use current revision
changes.after: Historical Version is explicit; source Versions remain immutable and no action auto-runs RF

invariants: No RF compute is launched by switch, inspect, continue, branch, duplicate, compare, or apply
Old Versions are never edited in place
Save version is explicit; autosave remains a draft persistence mechanism
Run and Report metadata remain separate from large Scenario payloads
Existing ProjectV2, Run History, and Report Artifact compatibility paths remain additive
